none: PAS WMID-B20138: Lead possible Roman curse tablet
contea di ritrovamento: Worcestershire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A rectangular strip of lead that has carefully and deliberately been folded in half. The object is just possibly a Roman curse tablet, although it may well be more modern and may have performed an entirely different function, perhaps such as a weight. If it is a curse tablet it may have an inscription on the interior requesting assistance from a deity. However, curse tablets do tend to be folded…
